name: edu-electronics-playground
description: EDU-ELN — an interactive analog electronics simulator: a hand-written circuit solver (modified nodal analysis + Newton-Raphson) runs your netlist, colours every wire by its potential, animates the currents, and puts a multimeter and a two-channel oscilloscope on the bench. Guided levels — from Ohm's law to finding the broken part with a probe — and a free sandbox. Zero dependencies, zero build.
